observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Grok Build 发布 v1.0.15 更新，会话与首条回复更快
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Grok Build 发布 v1.0.15 更新，会话开关更快、首条回复延迟降低、输入处理更顺畅。主要改动包括：会话关闭时记忆整理改为下次启动时后台执行；会话启动时后台建立模型连接以降低首条回复延迟；登录启动时在 agent spawn 阶段后台刷新过期 token；新建会话时 MCP 工具等启动工作转入后台。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 论文：LLM 排行榜名次很大程度由评测配置决定，gemma4-31b 得分可在 31% 到 89% 间波动
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 一篇论文在固定 12 个模型和 3，679 个问题的前提下，只改变提示词格式、选项顺序、打分方式等常规评测设置，结果排名大幅波动。gemma4-31b 得分在 31% 到 89% 之间，12 个模型中有 4 个至少在一种有效设置下排到第一；相邻模型平均 95.7% 的差距来自评测设置改变时会翻转答案的题目，最大不稳定来源是打分方式，即生成答案还是选最高似然选项。
observationAnalysis.author: X：Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai)

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 作者分享如何用 3 个现有监控摄像头的麦克风运行 BirdNet-Go，实现 24/7 本地鸟类声音识别，无需云服务和订阅费用。系统支持 RTSP 流、Google Perch v2 模型可识别 14，795 个物种、按物种设置 Discord 通知、新物种追踪、BirdWeather 数据共享，并可通过 MQTT 接入 Home Assistant，还能识别蝙蝠和青蛙。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Google SKILL.state 提升长程智能体任务准确率
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Google 提出 SKILL.state，用显式可变执行状态替代追加式对话历史，解决长程智能体运行变慢和上下文污染问题。模型每步仅读取不可变技能规范、当前结构化状态和最新观察，中间推理在生成有效状态更新后即被丢弃，提示词不再随运行增长。在多个数据集、模型和执行环境中，任务准确率提升，累计 token 消耗下降，且该抽象与架构无关，可移植到现有技能运行时。
observationAnalysis.author: X：Elvis Saravia (@omarsar0, DAIR.AI)

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: NVIDIA LPU 三种分离式推理架构解析
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal:
NVIDIA LPU 支持 3 种分离式推理：

1. Rubin Prefill + LPU Decode，实现最快交互性
2. Rubin Prefill + Rubin Decode Attention + LPU Decode FFN，面向曲线中段
3. Rubin Prefill + Rubin Decode Verification + LPU Drafter，面向曲线中左段

在低交互性场景下，纯 Rubin 仍占优势。期待 Rubin + LPU 在 AgentX 等开源智能体基准上的性能曲线表现。
observationAnalysis.author: X：SemiAnalysis (@SemiAnalysis_)

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Grok Bots 将 LLM 引用数据转化为运营闭环
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal:
Grok Bots 将 LLM 引用数据转化为一个运营闭环：

找到 ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini 和 Perplexity 已经引用的页面，联系那些页面的控制者，然后重新运行相同的查询，看看可见度是否发生变化。

AI 搜索正在改变品牌被发现的方式。

你现在可以通过与 MCP 对话来在 ChatGPT 中排名。

这里的思路是将引用本身视为可观测性数据。
observationAnalysis.author: X：Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai)

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon DocumentDB now supports direct major version upgrades to version 8.0
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) now supports in-place major version upgrades (MVU) directly from engine versions 3.6 and 4.0 to version 8.0. This upgrade capability removes the need for intermediate version upgrades and allows you to upgrade your version 3.6 or 4.0 clusters while preserving existing data, configurations, and cluster settings. Upgrading to version 8.0 provides access to the latest security patches, performance improvements, and new developer capabilities. Major version upgrades from DocumentDB 3.6 and 4.0 to 8.0 are available in all AWS regions where these versions are currently supported. To learn more about upgrading to Amazon DocumentDB 8.0, including detailed guidance on version differences and upgrade paths, visit the Amazon DocumentDB MVU documentation

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon Redshift now supports Apache Iceberg v3 tables
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Redshift now supports reading from and writing to Apache Iceberg v3 tables in your data lake. Apache Iceberg is an open table format, and its v3 release adds several new features. With this launch, Amazon Redshift introduces support for default column values, row lineage, and deletion vectors. With default column values, you can define an initial value that Amazon Redshift applies when no value is provided, simplifying schema evolution as you add columns to existing tables. Row lineage exposes pseudo-columns that track each row's identity and last-updated sequence number, so you can build incremental pipelines and CDC (change data capture) workflows that process only modified rows. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery introduces Recovery Plans for orchestrated application recovery
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (AWS DRS) now offers Recovery Plans, a capability that automates the sequential launch of multi-server applications during recovery and drills. Instead of launching servers one at a time and tracking dependencies manually, you define the recovery sequence once and run it with a single action when you need it. This addresses a common challenge for customers running applications made up of databases, application tiers, and supporting services that must come up in a specific order. Recovery Plans let you group servers into sequential steps with configurable wait times between them, so your application recovers predictably and consistently every time. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon EVS now supports i7i.metal-48xl Amazon EC2 instance type
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Today, we're announcing that Amazon Elastic VMware Service (Amazon EVS) now supports the i7i.metal-48xl Amazon Elastic Cloud Compute (Amazon EC2) bare-metal instance type, offering a higher core-count option with a newer generation processor to help you realize cost-performance benefits for your VMware-based workloads on AWS. With this release, you now have more options for running your virtual machines (VMs) on Amazon EVS environments and growing your cloud presence at your own pace, as your business demands. Powered by 5th generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors, i7i instances offer the best compute and storage performance for x86-based storage optimized instances in Amazon EC2, delivering up to 23% better compute performance and more than 10% better price performance over i4i instance

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: AWS Lambda introduces managed runtimes in public preview for Node.js 26 and Python 3.15
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Today, AWS Lambda introduces managed runtimes in public preview, starting with Node.js 26 and Python 3.15. This gives customers, partners and upstream language communities the opportunity to try upcoming managed runtimes before their general availability (GA) release and to share their feedback with the Lambda team. Previously, Lambda managed runtimes were launched directly as GA releases. Since the runtimes could immediately be used by production workloads, the Lambda team couldn’t make changes post-GA that might impact existing functions. Managed runtimes in public preview give you a chance to test your workloads and report issues before GA—while breaking changes are still possible, so we can act on your feedback. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon RDS now supports the latest CU for Microsoft SQL Server
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for SQL Server now supports the latest Cumulative Updates (CU) for Microsoft SQL Server. This release includes support for Microsoft SQL Server 2025 CU6 KB5093421 (RDS version 17.00.4055.5.v1). For additional information on the improvements and fixes included in these updates, see Microsoft documentation for KB5093421. We recommend that you upgrade your Amazon RDS for SQL Server instances to apply these updates using Amazon RDS Management Console, or by using the AWS SDK or CLI. You can learn more about upgrading your database instance in the Amazon RDS SQL Server User Guide for upgrading your RDS Microsoft SQL Server DB engine .
observationAnalysis.author: aws@amazon.com

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for Oracle now supports the Oracle July 2026 Release Update (RU) for Oracle Database versions 19c, 21c and 26ai. We recommend upgrading to the July 2026 RU as it includes security updates for Oracle database products. Starting with July 2026 releases, the naming format for an RU in Oracle Database 19c changes to .ru- .mrp- .r . For example, the RDS for Oracle July 2026 quarterly RU for Oracle Database 19c is named 19.0.0.0.ru-2026-07.mrp-2026-07.r1. When Oracle releases a monthly Critical Security Patch Update (CSPU) for Oracle Database 19c and 26ai, Amazon RDS will make it available as an MRP version that bundles the CSPU with additional Oracle-recommended fixes. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon EKS now supports multiple external OIDC identity providers per cluster
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) now supports multiple external OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity providers per cluster. You can associate up to 10 OIDC identity providers with a single cluster, giving you more flexibility in how you authenticate users and workloads to your Kubernetes clusters. Many organizations use different identity providers for different user populations, such as employees, contractors, and CI/CD systems. You can now associate each of these providers directly with your cluster, without consolidating users into a single provider or running an intermediary identity broker. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon Aurora now supports PostgreSQL 18.4, 17.10, 16.14, 15.18, and 14.23
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition now supports PostgreSQL versions 18.4, 17.10, 16.14, 15.18, and 14.23 which include bug fixes from the PostgreSQL community and Aurora-specific enhancements. We recommend upgrading to the latest minor versions to address known Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) and benefit from these improvements, as detailed in the release notes .  You can upgrade your databases during scheduled maintenance windows using automatic minor version upgrades. To simplify operations at scale, enable automatic minor version upgrades and use the AWS Organizations Upgrade Rollout Policy to orchestrate multiple upgrades in phases, validating on lower-priority environments before upgrading your most critical ones. For more information, see Upgrading Amazon Au
observationAnalysis.author: aws@amazon.com

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: MSK Replicator now supports OAuth 2.0 (SASL/OAUTHBEARER) authentication for replication from external Apache Kafka clusters to Amazon MSK
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon MSK Replicator now supports OAuth 2.0 (SASL/OAUTHBEARER) authentication for data replication from external Apache Kafka clusters - including on-premises, self-managed on AWS, or other cloud providers - to Amazon MSK Provisioned clusters . With this capability, external Apache Kafka clusters configured with OAuth/OIDC authentication can now use MSK Replicator to migrate workloads to Amazon MSK, support disaster recovery by using MSK-based clusters as a failover or backup target and enable data distribution across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. MSK Replicator is a feature of Amazon MSK that automates data replication between Kafka clusters, eliminating the need to manage custom replication infrastructure or configure open-source tools. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod enhances support for Ray
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now enhances support for Ray with built-in observability, resilient training, accelerated inference and managed development environments. Ray is a popular open-source framework for scaling AI workloads on a unified compute layer, from data processing and distributed training to reinforcement learning and model serving. Running Ray on Kubernetes at production scale can be an operational burden: job hangs, low GPU utilization from static team allocations, and multi-step observability setup. Also, lack of interactive development environment means every code change needs another job submission and familiarity with kubectl. HyperPod now brings easier development, resilient training, and accelerated inference to Ray. Data scientists create, edit, monitor, and delete Ray
observationAnalysis.author: aws@amazon.com

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: AWS ParallelCluster 3.16 adds an on-node diagnostics tool
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: AWS ParallelCluster 3.16 is now generally available with a new on-node diagnostics tool, cluster stability improvements, and an updated HPC and AI/ML software stack. pcluster-diag is a diagnostics tool built into the ParallelCluster AMIs that lets you run diagnostic checks on any cluster node with a single command, and get a structured report that makes it easier to identify issues. This release also hardens the cluster lifecycle with more resilient cluster creation, updates, and image builds. The software stack is refreshed, with updated NVIDIA driver, CUDA, EFA installer, and Slurm versions. To get started with pcluster-diag, see Troubleshooting with pcluster-diag . observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Starting today, Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for MySQL supports MySQL minor version 8.4.11, the latest minor released by community MySQL. In addition to operational improvements, MySQL 8.4.11 introduces support for post-quantum TLS (PQ-TLS) key exchange, providing you with post-quantum cryptography options for encrypting your data in-transit. We recommend upgrading to the newer minor versions to accept fixes for CVEs in prior versions of MySQL and to benefit from bug fixes, performance improvements, and new functionality added by the MySQL community. Learn more about the enhancements in RDS for MySQL 8.4.11 in the Amazon RDS user guide and MySQL 8.4.11 release notes. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Amazon SES now supports open and click tracking override parameters
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) now supports open and click tracking override parameters in the SendEmail and SendBulkEmail APIs. Senders can enable or disable open tracking and click tracking on an individual API call, rather than managing tracking preferences through separate configuration sets. Previously, controlling tracking behavior required maintaining a distinct configuration set for each combination of open- and click-tracking settings. observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Video generation models as world simulators
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We explore large-scale training of generative models on video data. Specifically, we train text-conditional diffusion models jointly on videos and images of variable durations, resolutions and aspect ratios. We leverage a transformer architecture that operates on spacetime patches of video and image latent codes. Our largest model, Sora, is capable of generating a minute of high fidelity video. Our results suggest that scaling video generation models is a promising path towards building general purpose simulators of the physical world.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Improving mathematical reasoning with process supervision
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve trained a model to achieve a new state-of-the-art in mathematical problem solving by rewarding each correct step of reasoning (“process supervision”) instead of simply rewarding the correct final answer (“outcome supervision”). In addition to boosting performance relative to outcome supervision, process supervision also has an important alignment benefit: it directly trains the model to produce a chain-of-thought that is endorsed by humans.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Forecasting potential misuses of language models for disinformation campaigns and how to reduce risk
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: OpenAI researchers collaborated with Georgetown University’s Center for Security and Emerging Technology and the Stanford Internet Observatory to investigate how large language models might be misused for disinformation purposes. The collaboration included an October 2021 workshop bringing together 30 disinformation researchers, machine learning experts, and policy analysts, and culminated in a co-authored report building on more than a year of research. This report outlines the threats that language models pose to the information environment if used to augment disinformation campaigns and introduces a framework for analyzing potential mitigations. Read the full report here.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning to play Minecraft with Video PreTraining
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We trained a neural network to play Minecraft by Video PreTraining (VPT) on a massive unlabeled video dataset of human Minecraft play, while using only a small amount of labeled contractor data. With fine-tuning, our model can learn to craft diamond tools, a task that usually takes proficient humans over 20 minutes (24,000 actions). Our model uses the native human interface of keypresses and mouse movements, making it quite general, and represents a step towards general computer-using agents.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Improving verifiability in AI development
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve contributed to a multi-stakeholder report by 58 co-authors at 30 organizations, including the Centre for the Future of Intelligence, Mila, Schwartz Reisman Institute for Technology and Society, Center for Advanced Study in the Behavioral Sciences, and Center for Security and Emerging Technologies. This report describes 10 mechanisms to improve the verifiability of claims made about AI systems. Developers can use these tools to provide evidence that AI systems are safe, secure, fair, or privacy-preserving. Users, policymakers, and civil society can use these tools to evaluate AI development processes.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Deep double descent
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We show that the double descent phenomenon occurs in CNNs, ResNets, and transformers: performance first improves, then gets worse, and then improves again with increasing model size, data size, or training time. This effect is often avoided through careful regularization. While this behavior appears to be fairly universal, we don’t yet fully understand why it happens, and view further study of this phenomenon as an important research direction.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: GPT-2: 1.5B release
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: As the final model release of GPT-2’s staged release, we’re releasing the largest version (1.5B parameters) of GPT-2 along with code and model weights to facilitate detection of outputs of GPT-2 models. While there have been larger language models released since August, we’ve continued with our original staged release plan in order to provide the community with a test case of a full staged release process. We hope that this test case will be useful to developers of future powerful models, and we’re actively continuing the conversation with the AI community on responsible publication.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Solving Rubik’s Cube with a robot hand
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve trained a pair of neural networks to solve the Rubik’s Cube with a human-like robot hand. The neural networks are trained entirely in simulation, using the same reinforcement learning code as OpenAI Five paired with a new technique called Automatic Domain Randomization (ADR). The system can handle situations it never saw during training, such as being prodded by a stuffed giraffe. This shows that reinforcement learning isn’t just a tool for virtual tasks, but can solve physical-world problems requiring unprecedented dexterity.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Fine-tuning GPT-2 from human preferences
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve fine-tuned the 774M parameter GPT-2 language model using human feedback for various tasks, successfully matching the preferences of the external human labelers, though those preferences did not always match our own. Specifically, for summarization tasks the labelers preferred sentences copied wholesale from the input (we’d only asked them to ensure accuracy), so our models learned to copy. Summarization required 60k human labels; simpler tasks which continue text in various styles required only 5k. Our motivation is to move safety techniques closer to the general task of “machines talking to humans,” which we believe is key to extracting information about human values.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Emergent tool use from multi-agent interaction
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve observed agents discovering progressively more complex tool use while playing a simple game of hide-and-seek. Through training in our new simulated hide-and-seek environment, agents build a series of six distinct strategies and counterstrategies, some of which we did not know our environment supported. The self-supervised emergent complexity in this simple environment further suggests that multi-agent co-adaptation may one day produce extremely complex and intelligent behavior.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Testing robustness against unforeseen adversaries
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve developed a method to assess whether a neural network classifier can reliably defend against adversarial attacks not seen during training. Our method yields a new metric, UAR (Unforeseen Attack Robustness), which evaluates the robustness of a single model against an unanticipated attack, and highlights the need to measure performance across a more diverse range of unforeseen attacks.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: GPT-2: 6-month follow-up
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’re releasing the 774 million parameter GPT-2 language model after the release of our small 124M model in February, staged release of our medium 355M model in May, and subsequent research with partners and the AI community into the model’s potential for misuse and societal benefit. We’re also releasing an open-source legal agreement to make it easier for organizations to initiate model-sharing partnerships with each other, and are publishing a technical report about our experience in coordinating with the wider AI research community on publication norms.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Microsoft invests in and partners with OpenAI to support us building beneficial AGI
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Microsoft is investing $1 billion in OpenAI to support us building artificial general intelligence (AGI) with widely distributed economic benefits. We’re partnering to develop a hardware and software platform within Microsoft Azure which will scale to AGI. We’ll jointly develop new Azure AI supercomputing technologies, and Microsoft will become our exclusive cloud provider—so we’ll be working hard together to further extend Microsoft Azure’s capabilities in large-scale AI systems.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Why responsible AI development needs cooperation on safety
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve written a policy research paper identifying four strategies that can be used today to improve the likelihood of long-term industry cooperation on safety norms in AI: communicating risks and benefits, technical collaboration, increased transparency, and incentivizing standards. Our analysis shows that industry cooperation on safety will be instrumental in ensuring that AI systems are safe and beneficial, but competitive pressures could lead to a collective action problem, potentially causing AI companies to under-invest in safety. We hope these strategies will encourage greater cooperation on the safe development of AI and lead to better global outcomes of AI.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: MuseNet
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve created MuseNet, a deep neural network that can generate 4-minute musical compositions with 10 different instruments, and can combine styles from country to Mozart to the Beatles. MuseNet was not explicitly programmed with our understanding of music, but instead discovered patterns of harmony, rhythm, and style by learning to predict the next token in hundreds of thousands of MIDI files. MuseNet uses the same general-purpose unsupervised technology as GPT-2, a large-scale transformer model trained to predict the next token in a sequence, whether audio or text.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Implicit generation and generalization methods for energy-based models
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve made progress towards stable and scalable training of energy-based models (EBMs) resulting in better sample quality and generalization ability than existing models. Generation in EBMs spends more compute to continually refine its answers and doing so can generate samples competitive with GANs at low temperatures, while also having mode coverage guarantees of likelihood-based models. We hope these findings stimulate further research into this promising class of models.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: AI safety needs social scientists
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve written a paper arguing that long-term AI safety research needs social scientists to ensure AI alignment algorithms succeed when actual humans are involved. Properly aligning advanced AI systems with human values requires resolving many uncertainties related to the psychology of human rationality, emotion, and biases. The aim of this paper is to spark further collaboration between machine learning and social science researchers, and we plan to hire social scientists to work on this full time at OpenAI.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: How AI training scales
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve discovered that the gradient noise scale, a simple statistical metric, predicts the parallelizability of neural network training on a wide range of tasks. Since complex tasks tend to have noisier gradients, increasingly large batch sizes are likely to become useful in the future, removing one potential limit to further growth of AI systems. More broadly, these results show that neural network training need not be considered a mysterious art, but can be rigorized and systematized.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Quantifying generalization in reinforcement learning
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’re releasing CoinRun, a training environment which provides a metric for an agent’s ability to transfer its experience to novel situations and has already helped clarify a longstanding puzzle in reinforcement learning. CoinRun strikes a desirable balance in complexity: the environment is simpler than traditional platformer games like Sonic the Hedgehog but still poses a worthy generalization challenge for state of the art algorithms.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning concepts with energy functions
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve developed an energy-based model that can quickly learn to identify and generate instances of concepts, such as near, above, between, closest, and furthest, expressed as sets of 2d points. Our model learns these concepts after only five demonstrations. We also show cross-domain transfer: we use concepts learned in a 2d particle environment to solve tasks on a 3-dimensional physics-based robot.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning complex goals with iterated amplification
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’re proposing an AI safety technique called iterated amplification that lets us specify complicated behaviors and goals that are beyond human scale, by demonstrating how to decompose a task into simpler sub-tasks, rather than by providing labeled data or a reward function. Although this idea is in its very early stages and we have only completed experiments on simple toy algorithmic domains, we’ve decided to present it in its preliminary state because we think it could prove to be a scalable approach to AI safety.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Glow: Better reversible generative models
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We introduce Glow, a reversible generative model which uses invertible 1x1 convolutions. It extends previous work on reversible generative models and simplifies the architecture. Our model can generate realistic high resolution images, supports efficient sampling, and discovers features that can be used to manipulate attributes of data. We’re releasing code for the model and an online visualization tool so people can explore and build on these results.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning Montezuma’s Revenge from a single demonstration
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve trained an agent to achieve a high score of 74,500 on Montezuma’s Revenge from a single human demonstration, better than any previously published result. Our algorithm is simple: the agent plays a sequence of games starting from carefully chosen states from the demonstration, and learns from them by optimizing the game score using PPO, the same reinforcement learning algorithm that underpins OpenAI Five.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Improving language understanding with unsupervised learning
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve obtained state-of-the-art results on a suite of diverse language tasks with a scalable, task-agnostic system, which we’re also releasing. Our approach is a combination of two existing ideas: transformers and unsupervised pre-training. These results provide a convincing example that pairing supervised learning methods with unsupervised pre-training works very well; this is an idea that many have explored in the past, and we hope our result motivates further research into applying this idea on larger and more diverse datasets.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Evolved Policy Gradients
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’re releasing an experimental metalearning approach called Evolved Policy Gradients, a method that evolves the loss function of learning agents, which can enable fast training on novel tasks. Agents trained with EPG can succeed at basic tasks at test time that were outside their training regime, like learning to navigate to an object on a different side of the room from where it was placed during training.

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’re releasing highly-optimized GPU kernels for an underexplored class of neural network architectures: networks with block-sparse weights. Depending on the chosen sparsity, these kernels can run orders of magnitude faster than cuBLAS or cuSPARSE. We’ve used them to attain state-of-the-art results in text sentiment analysis and generative modeling of text and images.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Competitive self-play
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve found that self-play allows simulated AIs to discover physical skills like tackling, ducking, faking, kicking, catching, and diving for the ball, without explicitly designing an environment with these skills in mind. Self-play ensures that the environment is always the right difficulty for an AI to improve. Taken alongside our Dota 2 self-play results, we have increasing confidence that self-play will be a core part of powerful AI systems in the future.

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’re releasing two new OpenAI Baselines implementations: ACKTR and A2C. A2C is a synchronous, deterministic variant of Asynchronous Advantage Actor Critic (A3C) which we’ve found gives equal performance. ACKTR is a more sample-efficient reinforcement learning algorithm than TRPO and A2C, and requires only slightly more computation than A2C per update.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: More on Dota 2
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Our Dota 2 result shows that self-play can catapult the performance of machine learning systems from far below human level to superhuman, given sufficient compute. In the span of a month, our system went from barely matching a high-ranked player to beating the top pros and has continued to improve since then. Supervised deep learning systems can only be as good as their training datasets, but in self-play systems, the available data improves automatically as the agent gets better.

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: We’ve created a bot which beats the world’s top professionals at 1v1 matches of Dota 2 under standard tournament rules. The bot learned the game from scratch by self-play, and does not use imitation learning or tree search. This is a step towards building AI systems which accomplish well-defined goals in messy, complicated situations involving real humans.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning from human preferences
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: One step towards building safe AI systems is to remove the need for humans to write goal functions, since using a simple proxy for a complex goal, or getting the complex goal a bit wrong, can lead to undesirable and even dangerous behavior. In collaboration with DeepMind’s safety team, we’ve developed an algorithm which can infer what humans want by being told which of two proposed behaviors is better.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Learning to cooperate, compete, and communicate
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Multiagent environments where agents compete for resources are stepping stones on the path to AGI. Multiagent environments have two useful properties: first, there is a natural curriculum—the difficulty of the environment is determined by the skill of your competitors (and if you’re competing against clones of yourself, the environment exactly matches your skill level). Second, a multiagent environment has no stable equilibrium: no matter how smart an agent is, there’s always pressure to get smarter. These environments have a very different feel from traditional environments, and it’ll take a lot more research before we become good at them.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Enterprise-Grade Precision for Long-Context Multimodal Embedding Inference on Cloud TPU
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Google Cloud has natively integrated TPU support into the vLLM serving engine, allowing developers to elastically scale high-demand embedding pipelines using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). To handle massive 15K+ token contexts for models like Qwen3-Embedding-8B, the engineering team implemented TPU-specific optimizations such as hardware-safe tensor alignment, JAX/XLA compilation pre-warming, and a hybrid StepPool architecture for chunked prefill management. These enhancements achieve near-perfect numerical parity with reference GPU baselines, and developers can immediately leverage the open-sourced setup recipes on the AI-Hypercomputer GitHub to build their own high-throughput semantic retrieval applications.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: How to Evaluate Live & Voice Agents in ADK
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Moving live voice agents from demo to production requires rigorous, automated testing to handle the unpredictability of real multi-turn conversations. ADK now provides native live evaluation, allowing developers to test graph-based agent workflows against LLM-driven simulated users that generate actual audio via Gemini TTS. By defining evaluation scenarios and natural-language rubrics, you can automatically score audio responses and tool executions, inspect the resulting transcripts in ADK Web, or run the CLI directly in your CI/CD pipeline.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Build zero-trust AI agents with Google's Agent Development Kit
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Building autonomous AI agents that mutate production state requires moving beyond soft system prompts to a robust zero-trust architecture. To secure Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) workflows against prompt injections and malicious execution, developers must implement hardware-backed cryptographic signatures for database writes, kernel-level sandboxing with gVisor for dynamic code, and deterministic semantic gateways for I/O validation. By enforcing these hard security boundaries at the infrastructure level, you can safely deploy multi-tool AI agents without risking unauthorized data manipulation or server compromise.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: HeyGen x Google Cloud: Bringing Avatar IV to TPUs
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: HeyGen ported their 18B+ parameter Avatar IV video generation model to Google Cloud's Trillium (v6e) TPUs via torchax and XLA, utilizing FSDP and Ulysses sequence parallelism across an eight-chip mesh. To achieve a 1.86x speedup for real-time streaming, the engineering team pipelined exposed all-to-all collectives, aligned sparse attention block sizes to eliminate mask padding, and bypassed softmax serial dependencies using a precomputed Cauchy-Schwarz upper bound. These custom Pallas kernel and compiler optimizations were deployed only after passing rigorous two-tier quality gates to guarantee byte-identical or mathematically equivalent pixel outputs.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Introducing Credentio: Open Source C++ Library for C2PA Content Credentials from Google
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Credentio is a newly released, open-source C++ library from Google that allows developers to integrate high-performance, local-first validation of C2PA Content Credentials into their client and server applications. By processing assets entirely locally with a highly optimized memory footprint, the library delivers instant validation verdicts for multi-gigabyte media files without incurring cloud latency, bandwidth costs, or data privacy risks. The library currently features deep manifest parsing alongside configurable trust list integration, and is available now on Google Source with future plans to support full credential generation and embedding.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Why Go is an Ideal Language for AI-Assisted Software Engineering
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: As AI coding assistants shift the developer's primary role from writing boilerplate to reviewing and maintaining systems, language choice becomes critical for long-term architectural integrity. Go directly addresses this new paradigm by utilizing its strict compiler, integrated toolchain, and uncompromising readability to provide deterministic guardrails that help AI models self-correct and generate highly standardized code. By enforcing ecosystem-wide consistency and strict backward compatibility, the Go platform empowers engineering teams to efficiently verify, optimize, and maintain high-velocity, AI-generated output in production environments.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Scaling AI Agent Infrastructure with the MCP Stateless updates
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: The 2026-07-28 Model Context Protocol (MCP) specification replaces legacy stateful constraints with a fully stateless core, enabling cloud-native horizontal scaling, serverless deployments, and standard round-robin load balancing. This architectural shift introduces standardized HTTP headers for efficient routing without deep packet inspection, caching controls, and Multi Round-Trip Requests (MRTR) to handle interactive and long-running tasks without blocking connections. Developers can immediately begin migrating their agentic applications to this highly scalable infrastructure using the newly available beta SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go, and C#.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Model routing with Google Cloud API Gateway
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Google Cloud API Gateway now offers a model routing feature in Public Preview, allowing developers to dynamically route traffic to models like Gemini, Claude, or OpenAI OSS-GPT without hardcoding endpoints or managing open-source proxies. Developers can easily configure these routing rules directly within their OpenAPI 3.x specifications by mapping virtual model names to specific backend targets on a shared host. Once deployed, the Gateway acts as a serverless ingress layer that accepts standard OpenAI-compatible requests, automatically transcodes the payload to the native schema of the target model, and routes the traffic on the fly.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Scaling real-time AI agents with session-aware load balancing
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Real-time AI agents break traditional request-response load balancing paradigms because they rely on long-lived, stateful bidirectional streams that obscure true server capacity. To solve this, developers must implement application-level session tracking directly within the runtime to accurately measure the committed concurrent workload of active conversations. By feeding these precise session counts alongside standard CPU utilization metrics into a hybrid routing algorithm, infrastructure can effectively distribute stateful AI traffic and prevent individual backend bottlenecks.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Enable on-demand expertise with Agent Skills in Genkit Go
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: To prevent context window bloat and reduce token consumption, Genkit Go introduces Agent Skills based on a progressive disclosure architecture. Developers can package specialized instructions, scripts, and references into modular SKILL.md bundles where only the frontmatter metadata is initially exposed to the agent's system prompt. When a task matches the skill's description, Genkit's middleware dynamically loads the full instruction body and associated assets, ensuring the model accesses precise workflows exactly when needed.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: How to use Google microbenchmarks for evaluating TPU performance
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Google's open-source TPU microbenchmark suite provides developers with granular performance metrics across Network, Compute, HBM, Host Transfer, and Attention components to validate real-world hardware capabilities. By leveraging these benchmarks to establish a Roofline model, engineers can accurately diagnose whether their machine learning workloads are compute-, memory-, or network-bound. This empirical baseline directly guides targeted software optimizations—such as kernel tuning, mesh sharding, and rematerialization—to maximize hardware utilization for large-scale model deployments.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Run Ray on TPU, Part 2: Ray AI libraries
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: This second installment explores how Ray’s higher-level libraries—Serve, Data, and Train—abstract the complexities of running AI workloads on Google's TPU slices. Ray Serve uses a simple topology configuration to correctly gang-schedule large multi-host models, while Ray Data eliminates data-loading bottlenecks by feeding accelerators directly with native JAX batches. Finally, JaxTrainer streamlines distributed training across TPUs by automatically handling cross-slice coordination, checkpointing, and fault tolerance.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Scaling Agentic RL: High-Throughput Agentic Training with Tunix
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Tunix is Google’s new JAX-native post-training library designed to eliminate TPU idling bottlenecks when training multi-turn, tool-using LLM reasoning agents. It maximizes hardware throughput by combining highly concurrent, asynchronous rollouts with a decoupled producer-consumer pipeline, ensuring the trainer is constantly fed even while agents wait on network I/O or environment steps. Additionally, Tunix provides plug-and-play abstractions and continuous macro-level profiling, allowing developers to easily integrate custom open-source environments and optimize complex distributed workflows without massive code rewrites.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Run Ray on TPU, Part 1: The foundations
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Ray 2.55 introduces official, first-class support for Google Cloud TPUs, enabling developers to run distributed Python workloads on Google's accelerators using the familiar Ray task-and-actor APIs. To handle the strict networking requirement of keeping multi-host TPU "slices" together over their Inter-Chip Interconnect (ICI), the KubeRay Operator on GKE automatically provisions and labels the underlying hardware layout. Ray Core utilizes these labels via its slice_placement_group() primitive to atomically reserve complete slices, allowing developers to deploy jobs through KubeRay, Ray Train, or Ray Serve simply by declaring a hardware topology (like "4x4") without writing custom placement code.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Building scalable AI agents with modular prompt transpilation
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: To resolve the scaling bottlenecks and runtime errors caused by monolithic system prompts, engineering teams should treat prompts as build artifacts by modularizing instructions into reusable templates. By running these modular "skill files" through a transpiler, developers can enforce static validation, catch missing dependencies at build time, and integrate prompt generation directly into their CI/CD pipelines. This deterministic approach prevents code drift and ultimately establishes a safe framework where agents can propose updates to their own logic via standard pull requests.

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Introducing Adaptive Intelligence: Undermining the economics of every bot attack
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: Bot operators have historically had the economic advantage, bypassing static, deterministic detection rules with cheap proxies and retooling. observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，分析师郭明錤昨日表示，其最新产业调查显示 NVIDIA（英伟达）已重启人工智能推理预填充加速 GPU "Rubin CPX" 项目 ，不过其设计得到了大幅度的调整，预计 2027Q1 开始生产。 在芯片级别， 新 Rubin CPX 拥有接近标准 Rubin GPU 的算力 ， 预填充性能进一步提升 ，单体最高功耗同为 2300W， 配备 168GB HBM4 内存 （IT之家注：旧 Rubin CPX 为 128GB GDDR7，168GB 或指向 7×24GB 设计）。 来到托盘与机架级别，8 颗新 Rubin CPX 构成 1 个计算托盘；8 个计算托盘构成 1 个机架模组，内部以 Spectrum-6 全铜以太网横向扩展 (Scale-out)；新 Rubin CPX 采用独立的 MGX ETL 机架，每个机架包含 1~4 组机架模组，机架模组间横向扩展则是 Spectrum-6 + OSFP 光学方案。 而在系统层面， NVIDIA 建议 Rubin CPX 与标准 Rubin 按 1:1 配对 ，Rubin CPX ETL 机架与 Vera Rubin NVL72 机架间采用基于以太网的 RDMA 连接。 这位分析师评论称，目前的 AI 推理工作量中超过 50% 来自处理输入并建立相应的 KV Cache，新 Rubin CPX 能以更具弹性的部署方式与更低成本承接预填充负载；新 Rubin CPX 计算托盘具备 1.34TB HBM 内存，足以满足大多数长上下文预填充与 KV Cache 建立需求。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 2027 款奇瑞星途揽月正式上市，限时权益价 14.99 万起
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，2027 款星途揽月今日正式上市，限时权益价 14.99 万元起。新车基于 M3X 火星架构打造，提供燃油及 C-DM 超混两种动力系统，并搭载 L2 级智能驾驶辅助系统。 购车权益方面，2027 款星途揽月燃油版限时至高可享 55000 元综合权益，包括 3000 元订金抵 23000 元车款、20000 元置换补贴等。C-DM 版限时至高可享 45000 元综合权益。 据介绍，9 月 30 日前下订的用户还可免费选装价值 5000 元的丹枫红 NAPPA 真皮内饰。首任车主均享基础流量终身免费、整车终身质保等权益。 外观方面，新车全系新增青竹灰车色，搭配超大横格栅前脸与贯穿式鹰翼后尾灯。燃油版顶配可选装黑化套件。车身超 5 米，轴距达 2900mm，提供 6/7 座灵活布局。二排腿部空间 901mm，三排腿部空间 793mm。内饰新增丹枫红配色，搭载 Lion5.0 雄狮智云系统与车规级高通 8155 芯片，支持 Carplay / HUAWEI HiCar 4.0/Carlink 车机互联。 配置方面，新车搭载伯牙之音 23 扬音响及 ANC 主动降噪技术。飞鱼四驱版可选装价值 20000 元的尊享选装包（限时 7000 元），含主驾膝部气囊、前排中间气囊等。IT之家注意到，主副驾座椅支持多向电动调节、靠背按摩、腰托腿托，二排座椅带加热通风，六座版增加靠背按摩。 燃油版顶配搭载 32 项高阶 ADAS 驾驶辅助系统，可实现 L2 级高速智能驾驶辅助，全车配备 5 个摄像头、16 个雷达。覆盖全国 243 个城市高快路，支持辅助超车变道、限速识别、上下匝道等功能。同时支持辅助泊车、记忆泊车、循迹倒车等全场景泊车功能。C-DM 版全系标配上述智驾功能。 动力方面，燃油版搭载 2.0T 高功率发动机，最大功率 192kW，峰值扭矩 400N·m

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 苹果首款折叠手机 iPhone Ultra 预估本月发售，首批供应“极其有限”
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，科技媒体 9to5Mac 昨日（8 月 31 日）发布博文，报道称苹果首款折叠手机（上市后预估名为 iPhone Ultra）上市首批供货紧张， 部分地区可能无法与美国市场同步购买。 北京时间 9 月 10 日凌晨 1 点召开的 2026 秋季发布会，对于苹果来说，具备非常重要的意义。在掌舵者方面，这是蒂姆 · 库克（Tim Cook）交棒后，新任 CEO 约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）主持召开首个新品发布会，是其履新后的首场重大公开活动。IT之家届时也会带来全程第一时间报道。 在产品方面，除了 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max 更迭外，诸多线索表明苹果会推出其首款折叠手机，上市后预估名为 iPhone Ultra。 路透社于 8 月 27 日发布博文，报道称 iPhone Ultra 预估今年 9 月在美国等少数市场发售， 且从供应链消息来看，目前没有证据表明该机会延后到 2027 年发售。 不过路透社也表示 iPhone Ultra 上市初期供货紧张， 铺货数量“极其有限” ，可能会加剧出现黄牛加价销售的情况。 在销售表现方面，彭博社此前援引市场调查机构 IDC 数据， 预估  iPhone Ultra 上市首年出货量超过 1000 万台 。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 华境 S 大六座 SUV 8 月交付 7306 台：连续 4 个月交付增长，售价 15.98 万元起
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，据博主 @孙少军09 分享， 华境 S 大六座 SUV 8 月交付 7306 台 ，实现连续 4 个月交付增长。 据IT之家此前报道，今年 8 月 17 日， 华境汽车宣布华境 S 累计交付量突破 20000 台 。该车于 5 月 8 日正式上市，共推出 4 款车型， 官方指导价 15.98-20.38 万元 。 华境 S 是上汽通用五菱与华为合作的首款搭载华为乾崑科技旗舰大六座 SUV，2026 年 7 月交付 7203 台、6 月交付 5689 台。华境 S 全系标配华为乾崑智驾 ADS Pro 增强版与鸿蒙座舱。 该车已于 5 月 8 日正式上市 ，上市即交付，锁单优先提。 200km 乾崑悦享版：官方指导价 15.98 万元，超级置换价 14.98 万元。 255km 乾崑臻享版：官方指导价 17.58 万元，超级置换价 16.58 万元。 255km 乾崑尊享版：官方指导价 18.58 万元，超级置换价 17.58 万元。 235km 四驱乾崑尊享版：官方指导价 20.38 万元，超级置换价 19.38 万元。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 广汽传祺 M8 第 50 万辆下线，成为首个突破 50 万销量的自主品牌豪华 MPV
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，广汽传祺昨晚宣布， 传祺 M8 第 50 万辆正式下线 ，该车成为了首个突破 50 万销量的自主品牌豪华 MPV，同时累计 75 个月获中国品牌豪华 MPV 销量冠军。 IT之家注意到，在广汽传祺 M8 第 50 万辆下线， 传祺 MPV 家族也已突破 90 万辆 。 据IT之家此前报道， 今年 6 月，广汽传祺向往 M8 PHEV L 正式上市 。 新车采用“一品麒麟”设计理念，采用大尺寸进气格栅搭配块状镀铬装饰，气场沉稳精致。车辆标配双侧电动滑移门，配备多幅豪华轮辋，顶配四驱 Ultra 版还搭载 ISD 智能交互尾灯，提升辨识度。 官方强调，该车搭载 1 颗激光雷达、12 个超声波雷达、3 个毫米波雷达及 11 颗摄像头，可实现城市 NDA 导航辅助、代客泊车等实用功能，车身还配备智驾专属指示灯。 该车内饰采用星河环抱式设计，配备 10.25 英寸仪表屏与 17.3 英寸中控屏，搭载高通骁龙 8295 芯片，内置 ADIGO SENSE 端云一体大模型，支持手机互联、哨兵模式等，座椅为 2+2+3 七座布局，除入门版本外，其余车型配备第二排零重力座椅；顶配车型额外配备二排扶手控制屏、多模式座椅按摩、第三排加热等舒适配置。 规格方面，该车车身尺寸为 5264mm×1898mm×1848（1829）mm，轴距 3070mm。搭载 1.5T 发动机，最大功率 125 千瓦，峰值扭矩 245 牛・米。采用前麦弗逊、后多连杆悬架组合，其中四驱 Ultra 版额外配套双阀 SDC 电磁悬架。传祺向往 M8 PHEV L 百公里亏电油耗低至 6.05L，CLTC 纯电续航 248km，综合续航超 1300km。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 三星推出入门级 14 英寸 Galaxy Book6 笔记本电脑：搭载 Wildcat Lake，799 美元起
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，三星电子今日宣布推出全新 14 英寸 Galaxy Book6，进一步扩充该产品线，起售价为 799 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 5,382 元人民币） 、119 万韩元 （现汇率约合 5,818 元人民币） 。 全新 Galaxy Book6 配备英特尔酷睿 3 或酷睿 5 处理器（Wildcat Lake），可选 8GB 或 16GB 内存以及 256GB、512GB 或 1TB SSD 存储；单次充电续航可达 25 小时，并支持 45W 快充（30 分钟可充入约 33% 电量）。 据介绍，其机身厚度 15.7 毫米，重量 1.35 公斤，提供银灰色（Violet Silver）和经典灰色两种配色，其中银灰色为 Galaxy Book 系列首次引入。 该机采用了 16:10 比例的 LCD 屏幕，支持防眩光技术。接口方面，该机配备两个 USB Type-C、一个 USB Type-A、HDMI 1.4 及 3.5mm 耳机孔；提供多种 AI 功能。 三星 Galaxy Book6 313.0 x 221.0 x 15.7 mm，1.35 kg 系统 Win11 25H2 专业版 / 家庭版 Linux 屏幕 14.0 英寸 LCD WUXGA (1920×1200)，350 nits CPU 英特尔酷睿 5 处理器 315 英特尔酷睿 3 处理器 304 NPU 英特尔 NPU，最高 15 TOPS GPU Intel Graphics 网络 Wi-Fi 6E、蓝牙 5.4、802.11 ax 2×2 颜色 紫银色，灰色 内存 8GB/16GB (LPDDR5X) 存储 256GB/512GB/1TB (PCIe) 相机 2MP（1080p FHD） 音频 内置双阵列数字麦克风， 立体声扬声器（2W x 2），杜比全景声 键盘 非背光键

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 小米汽车：目前市面上超过 65% 的增程车，CLTC 纯电续航标称值都不到 300km
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，小米汽车官方今日凌晨发布答网友问（第 285 集），针对澎程 N90 Max 此次上海到北京 1230km“中途不充电、不加油”如何实现、实测高速纯电续航 323.6km 意味着什么等问题进行了集中解答。 IT之家附小米汽车本集答网友问重点内容如下： 上海到北京，1230km，中途不充电、不加油是怎么实现的？工况如何？ 这次挑战是上海到北京， 全程顶着高速限速跑，平均时速 104km/h 。车速越快，风阻越大（120km/h 时风阻是 80km/h 的 2.25 倍），对电耗和油耗都是实打实的考验。 含金量在于， 高速综合续航 1230km 不是完全靠“大油箱”或“大电池”堆出来的，而是电耗和亏电油耗都做到了足够低 。如果简单换算，同级燃油 SUV 跑完 1230km 需要约 123L 油，但它们的油箱通常在 80-90L；同级纯电 SUV 则需要约 209kWh 的电，而量产车很少配 130kWh 以上电池。 在能耗没有大幅降低的前提下，电池容量与油箱容积，分别就是两种能源形式的续航瓶颈 。 小米昆仑超级增程通过精密的系统耦合，绕开了上述两重限制。 基础是 76kWh 电池 + 60L 油箱 ，等于给车辆配了两个能量源，再把高速电耗和高速亏电油耗同时做到了足够低， 这是实现高速综合续航 1230km 的关键所在 。 实测高速纯电续航跑了 323.6km，这个数字意味着什么？跟日常用车有什么关系？ 首先回顾一个事实， 我们的测试统计到增程器介入（电量剩 10%）为止，实测高速纯电续航是 323.6km 。如果把剩余电量强制用到 3%， 实际高速纯电续航约为 348.77km 。 这跟日常用车的关系在于， 目前市面上超过 65% 的增程车，CLTC 纯电续航标称值都不到 300km ，实际跑高速普遍打七折，也就 200km 出头。这意味着单程 1

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 2027 款上汽大众帕萨特 Pro 车型正式上市：官方指导价 17.2 万元起，限时优惠价 13.99 万元起
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，上汽大众 2027 款帕萨特 Pro 昨日正式上市。新车共推出 5 款车型，官方指导价 17.2-23.99 万元，限时一口价 13.99-20.99 万元。 此次上市的 2027 款帕萨特 Pro 为年度改款车型，定位纯燃油中型家轿。上市权益包括动力总成终身质保、最高 1.2 万元以旧换新补贴、2 年 0 息金融政策及无忧流量权益等。 外观延续了现款设计，前脸为标志性 IQ.Light 矩阵式 LED 大灯与大嘴熏黑进气格栅。提供比特灰、超感黑、镭射白、瞬息白四种车色，并换装了全新双色轮圈，保留了传统机械式门把手。IT之家注意到，车尾采用贯穿式尾灯，且大众 Logo 可随车头 Logo 一同点亮；下包围保留蜂窝状装饰与隐藏式排气布局。 内饰沿用现款设计，高配车型配备 15 英寸中控大屏及 11.6 英寸副驾娱乐屏。还搭载了前排座椅加热 / 通风、360 度全景影像、透明底盘、10 安全气囊、电动尾门、后排遮阳帘及哈曼卡顿音响等配置。 动力方面，新车提供 1.5T 和 2.0T 两款发动机，均匹配 7 挡双离合变速箱。1.5T 发动机最大功率 160 马力，峰值扭矩 250 牛 · 米；2.0T 发动机最大功率 220 马力，峰值扭矩 350 牛 · 米。其中 2.0T 车型 0-100km/h 加速时间为 7.6 秒，WLTC 综合油耗为 6.87L/100km。 相关阅读： 《 上汽大众途观 L Pro 2027 款上市，限时置换价 14.99 万元起 》

analysis.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，上汽大众 2027 款帕萨特 Pro 昨日正式上市。新车共推出 5 款车型，官方指导价 17.2-23.99 万元，限时一口价 13.99-20.99 万元。 此次上市的 2027 款帕萨特 Pro 为年度改款车型，定位纯燃油中型家轿。上市权益包括动力总成终身质保、最高 1.2 万元以旧换新补贴、2 年 0 息金融政策及无忧流量权益等。 外观延续了现款设计，前脸为标志性 IQ.Light 矩阵式 LED 大灯与大嘴熏黑进气格栅。提供比特灰、超感黑、镭射白、瞬息白四种车色，并换装了全新双色轮圈，保留了传统机械式门把手。IT之家注意到，车尾采用贯穿式尾灯，且大众 Logo 可随车头 Logo 一同点亮；下包围保留蜂窝状装饰与隐藏式排气布局。 内饰沿用现款设计，高配车型配备 15 英寸中控大屏及 11.6 英寸副驾娱乐屏。还搭载了前排座椅加热 / 通风、360 度全景影像、透明底盘、10 安全气囊、电动尾门、后排遮阳帘及哈曼卡顿音响等配置。 动力方面，新车提供 1.5T 和 2.0T 两款发动机，均匹配 7 挡双离合变速箱。1.5T 发动机最大功率 160 马力，峰值扭矩 250 牛 · 米；2.0T 发动机最大功率 220 马力，峰值扭矩 350 牛 · 米。其中 2.0T 车型 0-100km/h 加速时间为 7.6 秒，WLTC 综合油耗为 6.87L/100km。 相关阅读： 《 上汽大众途观 L Pro 2027 款上市，限时置换价 14.99 万元起 》

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 微信鸿蒙版 App 获 8.0.21.34 版本邀测升级，修复了一些已知问题
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，微信鸿蒙版 App 昨日在华为应用市场（App Gallery）开启了 8.0.21.34 (8394018) 版本邀测升级（需收到短信通知后点击链接跳转安装，未收到短信需继续等待），测试时间为 2026/8/31-2026/9/30。 微信鸿蒙版 8.0.20 系列自 7 月底以来已连续推送多个邀测与尝鲜版本，官方更新日志均为“修复了一些已知问题”。 IT之家这里也提供一份由网友 @伤心萨摩耶、MeoW 整理的 8.0.21 和 8.0.20 版本已知灰度测试内容（不绑定版本号）： 8.0.21 版本已知内容： 1.私聊设置打开免打扰之后支持折叠聊天； 2.通讯录-公众号 / 服务号列表左滑新增“不再关注”； 3.视频号等界面点击分享后按钮 UI 优化，视频号分享新增“复制链接”； 4.发现-直播新增右侧红点推荐消息提醒； 5.发现-视频号-个人中心-设置新增“谁可以看我的视频号内容”、“谁可以发评论”、“谁可以向我打招呼”设置项，我的视频号-隐私设置同步新增上述三设置项（8.0.21.33 已暂时收回）； 6.视频号发起直播时支持直播带货，路径：发起直播-更多-商品； 7.听一听-个人歌单右上角新增沉浸听歌空间，支持共享电台，个人歌单新增解锁分类（该分类需灰度到 AI 创作相关功能，展示 AI 创作的歌曲）； 8.设置-通用-辅助功能新增微信支付商家助手； 9.设置-朋友权限新增“常用打招呼语”，支持设置常用打招呼内容（逐步开放，疑似三端同步灰度）； 10.微信相机界面新增焦段和微距按钮，支持按住滑动选择精确焦段（逐步开放）； 11.转发弹窗重构，新增支持转发留言输入表情（逐步开放）； 12.我-表情新增搜索框，支持搜索表情专辑和表情（逐步开放）； 13.收付款底部新增“添加到桌面”（逐步开放，8.0.20 已支持灰度）； 14.设置-通用

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 苹果 MacBook Neo 8GB 被曝 SSD 寿命隐患：3 小时写入近 900GB，高强度下寿命不足两月
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，YouTube 频道 UFD Tech 经过测试发现，苹果 MacBook Neo 存在 SSD 寿命隐患，其 8GB 内存配置可能因过度依赖 SSD 交换文件而严重影响硬盘使用寿命。 测试中，UFD Tech 使用 SSD 写入工具发现，256GB 版 MacBook Neo 在写入 20TB 数据后消耗了约 5% 的 SSD 寿命，据此推算其总写入寿命约为 414TB；512GB 版总寿命则约为 1521TB。 随后，主持人 Brett 模拟日常轻度使用（运行 Chrome、WhatsApp 和 Discord）进行实测，结果显示仅 3 小时就向 SSD 写入了近 900GB 数据。 若按 414TB 寿命计算，该 SSD 在高强度交换读写下，理论寿命仅约 1400 小时（约 58 天）。512GB 版因容量优势，预期寿命约为 5000 小时。 测试者承认实际使用结果因人而异，但 MacBook Neo 的 SSD 为不可更换设计，一旦寿命耗尽，维修成本高昂且面临数据丢失风险。 IT之家注：TBW（Terabytes Written，总写入字节数）是衡量 SSD 寿命的关键指标，代表硬盘在其生命周期内可写入的总数据量。 值得注意的是，市场普遍预期苹果将在下一代 MacBook Neo 中解决此问题。多方消息称，苹果正计划为 MacBook Neo 2 搭载 A19 Pro 芯片，并将内存从 8GB 提升至 12GB。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: Steam PvE 生存建造节开启：《幻兽帕鲁》七折 75.6 元、《雾锁王国》新史低，持续至 9 月 8 日
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，Steam 现已开启 PvE 生存建造节特卖活动，本次活动将持续至北京时间约为 9 月 8 日凌晨 1 点，活动期间大量 PvE 生存建造类游戏将提供折扣优惠，点数商店也推出了新头像、边框、贴纸。 本次特卖涵盖各类别生存建造题材游戏，测试玩家在不同恶劣环境下的求生能力，包括海上漂流、深海探险、太空生存、荒岛求生等不同主题作品均参与折扣。 在此次活动中，《幻兽帕鲁》七折平史低，国区售价 75.6 元；《雾锁王国》七五折新史低 73.5 元；《禁闭求生》（Grounded）五折平史低 59.5 元；《灵魂面甲》六五折新史低 70.2 元；《泰拉瑞亚》五折平史低 21 元；《木筏求生》（Raft）立减 33% 后 51.59 元；《方舟: 生存飞升》二五折平史低 62 元；《深海迷航》二五折 37.25 元；《中世纪王朝》五折平史低 44.44 元；《森林》立减 78% 后 15.4 元；《森林之子》三折平史低 32.4 元。 此外，《七日杀》立减 45% 后 83.6 元；《DayZ》五折 139.5 元；《僵尸毁灭工程》（Project Zomboid）立减 33% 后 62.31 元。 官方表示，玩家可以在这些精彩游戏中，发挥自己的建造工艺技术，这是在恶劣环境中求生的唯一方式，感兴趣的玩家可以前往活动页面挑选购买。 IT之家附活动页面链接： https://store.steampowered.com/category/pve_survival_crafting 。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 微软更新 Win11 26H1 预览版 28020.2818/28120.2824：升级 WinRE 联网，修复壁纸变黑 Bug 等
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，微软昨天（8 月 31 日）发布博文， 邀请 Beta 频道的 Windows Insider 项目成员，测试适用于 Windows 11 的最新预览版更新。 版本号方面，适用于 26H1 的 Beta 版本号为 Build 28020.2818；适用于 26H1 的 Experimental 版本号为 Build 28120.2824。 在更新内容方面，此次更新的最大亮点是 Windows 恢复环境（WinRE）新增网络能力。在现有 Windows 11 系统中，WinRE 只能自动连接有线以太网或预配置的 Wi-Fi 网络，用户须手动为 WPA2/3 网络输入密码。 新版本让 WinRE 可直接调用主系统中已保存的 Wi-Fi 凭据，包括支持证书认证的网络，主要服务于 " 快速故障恢复 " 与 " 云端重装系统 " 等场景，目的是减少用户手动配置步骤。功能默认启用，但企业 IT 管理员可根据安全策略选择关闭。 IT之家附上本次更新内容如下： 1、个性化设置 提升「设置 > 个性化 > 背景」页面运行稳定性 新增支持 DIB 图像文件用作桌面壁纸 提升新建账户下桌面幻灯片壁纸切换的可靠性 优化「设置 > 个性化 > 背景」壁纸选择界面预览图分辨率 改善竖屏显示器设备下设置内桌面壁纸预览显示效果 优化短时间连续切换桌面壁纸时的处理稳定性 多桌面环境支持幻灯片壁纸，不会被强制重置为单张图片模式 修复上个预览版本部分设备重启后壁纸变黑的故障 2、打印管理 临时移除预览版中新设计的现代化打印管理界面，微软将基于用户反馈继续打磨该功能；传统打印管理工具完整保留，不受改动影响。 待后续迭代完善后，现代化打印管理界面会重新向预览体验用户推送。 3、文件资源管理器 文件资源管理器主页记忆各分组展开 / 折叠状态，重新打开会保持上次浏览状态。 4、放大镜（Ma

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 2017/2018 款 MacBook Pro 与 2018 款 MacBook Air 正式进入苹果过时名单
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，苹果今日更新了过时产品名单，新增的设备包括： 2018 款 13 英寸视网膜显示屏 MacBook Air； 配备四个雷雳 3 端口的 2018 款 13 英寸 MacBook Pro； 配备两个雷雳 3 端口的 2017 款 13 英寸 MacBook Pro。 根据苹果的政策，当一款产品停止销售满五年即被归为“老旧产品”（Vintage），满七年则被列为“过时产品”（Obsolete）。 老旧产品在零件供应充足的情况下仍可维修，而过时产品通常不再享有官方硬件维修服务，苹果也会停止生产相关维修部件。 IT之家注：苹果对 Mac 笔记本电脑提供最长十年的电池专项维修政策，期限从产品最后一次销售起计算。因此，2017 款和 2018 款 MacBook Pro 及 2018 款 MacBook Air 的用户未来仍可能获得电池更换服务，具体取决于零件供应情况。 2018 款 MacBook Air 是 Air 系列中首款配备 Touch ID 和视网膜显示屏的机型。相比此前的非视网膜屏幕，新屏幕分辨率更高、色彩更鲜艳。同年苹果还重新设计了 MacBook Air，采用更窄的边框和更薄、更轻的机身。 2017 款 MacBook Pro 主要升级为英特尔 Kaby Lake 处理器，其他方面的变化较为有限。2018 年的更新则首次带来了原彩显示支持，并搭载了第三代蝶式键盘。

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，苹果今日向 Mac 电脑用户推送了 macOS 27.0 开发者预览版 Beta 8 更新（内部版本号：26A5425a），本次更新距离上次发布 Beta / RC 间隔 7 天。开发者可在系统设置 > 通用 > 软件更新中下载，需开启 Beta 更新并登录免费开发者账户。 macOS Golden Gate（IT之家注：命名源自美国旧金山的金门大桥）带来多项设计改进，包括优化 Liquid Glass 透明度以提高可读性，并增加滑块供用户调节透明程度，同时调整窗口阴影以更清晰地区分活动状态。应用界面采用统一工具栏、边缘到边缘的侧边栏并减小了圆角半径，菜单栏图标数量也有所精简。 Siri 升级为 Siri AI，成为具备聊天机器人风格的智能助手。它整合通用知识、个人数据与屏幕内容感知，可回答各类问题并协助查找信息。Siri 集成于 Spotlight 中，用户可通过新的“搜索或询问”界面提问。新版 Siri 应用可查看历史对话记录；新款 Mac 还支持设置自定义语音，调整语速与表现力。“视觉智能”功能现登陆 Mac，Siri 可回答关于屏幕内容的问题；“用 Siri 写作”功能则可生成文本或提供写作反馈。 此外，照片应用新增 AI 照片编辑工具，Safari 加入 AI 标签页整理功能，密码应用可利用 AI 自动更新弱密码，全新的 Image Playground 应用也支持生成写实风格图片。 如何升级 iOS / iPadOS / watchOS / macOS 开发版和公测版？ • 公开测试版 ：需注册  Apple Beta 版软件计划 ，之后通过【设置】【通用】【软件更新】【Beta 版更新】来升级； • 开发预览版 ：需登录注册 苹果开发者计划 ，之后通过【设置】【通用】【软件更新】来升级。 附苹果 iOS 历史固件下载大全

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 苹果 visionOS 27.0 开发者预览版 Beta 8 发布
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，苹果今日向 Vision Pro 用户推送了 visionOS 27.0 开发者预览版 Beta 8 更新（内部版本号：24M5361a），本次更新距离上次发布 Beta / RC 间隔 7 天。 开发者可在 Vision Pro 上打开“设置”应用，进入“软件更新”并开启“Beta 更新”即可安装。 需要注意的是，因苹果各区域节点服务器配置缓存问题，可能有些地方探测到升级更新的时间略有延迟，一般半小时内，不会太久。 visionOS 27 的核心更新是引入 Siri AI，使其具备类似 ChatGPT 和 Claude 的对话与推理能力。在 Vision Pro 上，Siri 可回答用户注视内容相关问题，并新增了一个可在虚拟空间中任意放置的 Siri 球体。 系统可将全景照片转换为沉浸式空间环境，并新增冰岛索斯莫克（Thórsmörk）环境，展示山脉、山谷、冰川及北极光景观。Web 环境支持允许开发者在 Safari 中创建 360 度浏览体验。应用窗口采用弧形设计以增强沉浸感；控制中心重新布局，便于查找系统功能。此外，新增了更小尺寸的小组件，且通知会在用户注视时自动展开。 附 visionOS 27 发布历史： 2026-08-25：visionOS 27.0 Beta 7 (24M5359a) 2026-08-18：visionOS 27.0 Beta 6 (24M5355a) 2026-08-11：visionOS 27.0 Beta 5 (24M5348b) 2026-07-21：visionOS 27.0 Beta 4 (24M5326g) 2026-07-07：visionOS 27.0 Beta 3 (24M5316k) 2026-06-23：visionOS 27.0 Beta 2 (24M5306i) 2026-06-09：

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 【 点此直达升级教程 】 IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，苹果今日向 Apple Watch 用户推送了 watchOS 27.0 开发者预览版 Beta 8 更新（内部版本号：24R5360a），本次更新距离上次发布 Beta / RC 间隔 7 天。 开发者可通过 iPhone 上的 Watch App，使用免费开发者账户下载更新。安装时手表需连接充电器、接入 Wi-Fi，且电量保持在 50% 以上。 watchOS 27 的最大亮点是引入 Siri AI。新版 Siri 支持多轮对话，可结合通用知识与个人数据回答问题。值得注意的是，手表上的 Siri AI 功能需搭配支持 Apple Intelligence 的 iPhone（iPhone 15 Pro 及后续机型）。 系统还引入了动态应用网格，可智能高亮 Siri 推荐应用；智能叠放（Smart Stack）提供更直观的建议。新增“查找”应用整合了精准查找（Precision Finding）功能。 Workout Buddy 现在无需 iPhone 即可独立运作，并新增了距离、配速或时长等渐进式指标。Liquid Glass 设计也提升了可读性。 此外，用户还可查找停车位置、查看固定信息、接收噪音警报及管理交通卡等。系统还通过性能优化改善了电池续航。 如何升级 iOS / iPadOS / watchOS / macOS 开发版和公测版？ • 公开测试版 ：需注册  Apple Beta 版软件计划 ，之后通过【设置】【通用】【软件更新】【Beta 版更新】来升级； • 开发预览版 ：需登录注册 苹果开发者计划 ，之后通过【设置】【通用】【软件更新】来升级。 附苹果 iOS 历史固件下载大全： 《 苹果 iOS / iPadOS / macOS 固件下载 / 更新日志大全 》 附 watchOS 27 发

observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: 【 点此直达升级教程 】 IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，苹果今日向 iPhone 和 iPad 用户推送了 iOS / iPadOS 27.0 开发者预览版 Beta 8 更新（内部版本号：24A5430a），本次更新距离上次发布 Beta / RC 间隔 7 天。 更新节奏方面，Beta 8 版本后缀为 a，包括 9to5Mac 在内的多家海外媒体认为距离苹果发布 iOS 27 RC 候选版本已经不远。 更新内容方面，IT之家查询相关资料，相比较 Beta 7 更新，在最新发布的 Beta 8 更新中，暂未发现新增变化，且伴随着 iOS 27 开发进入尾声，后续更新以修复 Bug、提高稳定性为主。 iOS 27 将 Siri 升级为具备聊天机器人能力的 AI 服务。它可结合通用知识、信息和邮件等应用中的个人数据，以及屏幕内容回答问题。系统还加快应用启动、AirDrop 传输、键盘唤起和 Wi‑Fi 与蜂窝网络切换。 彭博社的马克 · 古尔曼（Mark Gurman）今天（9 月 1 日）发布推文，指出这是非常罕见的 Beta 8 更新。 如何升级 iOS / iPadOS / watchOS / macOS 开发版和公测版？ • 公开测试版 ：需注册  Apple Beta 版软件计划 ，之后通过【设置】【通用】【软件更新】【Beta 版更新】来升级； • 开发预览版 ：需登录注册 苹果开发者计划 ，之后通过【设置】【通用】【软件更新】来升级。 附苹果 iOS 历史固件下载大全： 《 苹果 iOS / iPadOS / macOS 固件下载 / 更新日志大全 》 附 iOS / iPadOS 27 发布历史： 2026-08-25：iOS 27.0 Beta 7 (24A5424a) 2026-08-18：iOS 27.0 Beta 6 (24A5418b) 2

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 库克担任苹果 CEO 最后一天给员工发告别信：将公司交给约翰 · 特努斯让我无比安心
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 8 月 31 日消息，今天是蒂姆 · 库克担任苹果首席执行官的最后一天。现任苹果硬件工程高级副总裁约翰 · 特努斯将在明天接任他的工作，库克后续会转任苹果董事会执行主席，并继续负责与全球政策制定者沟通等事务。 为了纪念自己 CEO 任期的最后一天，库克今天早上向苹果员工发送了一封充满感情的备忘录，这封告别信回顾了库克在苹果度过的时光，还对特努斯表达了期许。 IT之家附库克备忘录全文如下： 今天是我担任苹果首席执行官的最后一天。我知道这一天终会到来，但当它真正到来、我真正坐下来写这封信的时候，我仍然很难相信这一切已经成为现实。我热爱这家公司，也热爱背后的团队。今天我必须写出这封信，感谢你们给予我的深切关爱，和每天的付出和支持。最重要的是，我要感谢你们，让我拥有人生中最宝贵的机会 —— 成为你们的领导者。 说实话，无论人们如何评价我的成功，我都知道这一切归功于你们，是你们让我成为更好的自己。我在苹果之前从未见过、也从未与如此非凡的一群人共事。每天，我都能看到更多这样的例子。 苹果确实有着某种独到之处。我最引以为豪的东西，恰恰是年度报告永远无法体现的。这里证明了文化的力量，我们共同坚信自己创造的一切都意义非凡，我们有机会也有责任让世界变得更美好。这种使命感造就了苹果的非凡之处，苹果培育了这种精神，但我相信这些精神早在你们到来之前，就已经根植于每个人心中。并且这股动力将你们带到了这家公司，也一直驱动着你们每天创造的事物。 我们共同创造出的事业，已经远远超越任何一个人单独想象或完成的事情，这是我们成功的秘诀。我们彼此激发，互相扶持。我们之所以能够像史蒂夫 · 乔布斯当年所言那样，在世界上留下属于自己的“印记”，正是源于我们的特质与信念，以及价值观和世界观。我们何其幸运，而我又何其有幸。 正如你们所知道的那样，我不会离开苹果，但我将离开我深爱的岗位。即使我完全接受、认同自己的

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 七彩虹 iGame X870E VULCAN W OC 主板发售：超频旗舰，3999 元
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 8 月 31 日消息，七彩虹 (Colorful) 超频旗舰主板 iGame X870E VULCAN W OC V14“白火神”现已发售，定价 3999 元。 京东 七彩虹 iGame X870E VULCAN W OC V14 主板 3999 元 直达链接 iGame X870E VULCAN W OC V14 可视为 iGame X870E VULCAN OC V14“黑火神”调整 + 白化后的产物，整体配置基本一致。 其 采用 10 层沉金 + 背钻工艺 2oz 铜 PCB ， 搭载充足的 18+2+2 相 110A DrMOS 供电 ，内置时钟控制芯片，拥有优化后的“火神智屏”显示-控制模块，配备新一代按钮式显卡快拆结构。 这款主板支持 10600+ MT/s 内存超频，M.2 SSD 从 3 个 Gen5 & 2 个 Gen4 降级至 2 个 Gen5 & 3 个 Gen4，支持 5GbE LAN 和 Wi-Fi 7 (320MHz) WLAN。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 博通推出 VMware AI 工厂，简化企业私有云 AI 部署
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 8 月 31 日消息，博通公司今天宣布推出 VMware AI 工厂。新产品是 VMware AI 私有云的软件定义基础，通过一系列自动化创新功能为 AI 基础设施部署提供支持， 进而为客户提供更加简单的 AI 生产力部署路径 。 据介绍，VMware  AI 工厂可将 AI 应用直接部署到企业私有云环境。其 VCF（IT之家注：VMware Cloud Foundation）具备独特的基础设施自动化能力，可将服务器部署到 AI 模型开始服务，从数周缩短至数小时。 VCF 可在整个企业内部汇集 GPU 资源，使不同团队在共享硬件上运行多个模型，不必为每个 AI 单独配置服务器。统一模型库可为数据科学团队提供单一界面，在虚拟机、容器和 GPU 资源之间部署及管理模型推理和 RAG 工作流。 该平台还内置了可观测性功能，用于监控 Token 吞吐量、延迟，以及计算和内存利用率， 帮助企业将 Token 利用率最大化 。 VMware AI 工厂将支持思科、戴尔、联想、超微等厂商的 VCF AI ReadyNodes 认证产品，同时支持客户偏好的 AI 软件和加速器架构， 兼容 Gemma 4、cotomi、Qwen 3.7-Max、GLM 5.2 等 AI 大模型 。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 整治 AI 虚假账号，Instagram 推出全新 AI 个人资料标签
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 8 月 31 日消息，社交媒体 Instagram 今天宣布将原本的“AI 创作者”标签更新为“AI 生成个人资料”，使用户能够一眼分辨出眼前的创作者究竟是真人，还是 AI 生成的虚假人物。 IT之家了解到， 该标签适用于高度拟真且从未主动披露虚拟身份的 AI 生成账号 。真实创作者使用 AI 编辑工具处理照片、撰写标题，不会受到影响。 Instagram 表示，用户已经对一些看似真人、实际上是 AI 虚构的账号感到厌倦。今后如果有创作者不主动披露 AI 虚构身份，平台算法将不再将其内容推荐至 Reels、Explore 页面的非粉丝用户。如果平台自动标记算法出现偏差，用户可以联系官方客服申诉。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 华硕灵耀 14 骁龙版笔记本首销：骁龙 X 处理器，16GB+512GB 售 6999 元
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 8 月 31 日消息，华硕灵耀 14 骁龙版笔记本今晚正式开售，搭载骁龙 X 处理器，配备 16GB 内存和 512GB SSD，建议零售价 7999 元， 首发 6999 元 。 该机整体厚度 13.9mm，重量 1.1Kg，B 面配备一块 14 英寸 2880×1800 分辨率 120Hz OLED 面板（峰值亮度 1100 尼特，覆盖 100% DCI-P3 色域），C 面配备 1.7mm 长键程键盘。 该机搭载 8 核心 8 线程高通骁龙 X（X1-26-100）处理器，匹配 16GB LPDDR5X 内存（频率 8448MT/s）和 512GB PCIe 4.0 SSD，内置 50Wh 电池。 I/O 方面，这款笔记本提供 USB-A 3.2 Gen 1、双 USB-C 3.2 Gen 2、HDMI 2.1 TMDS、3.5mm 音频接口。 IT之家附这款笔记本亮点如下： 京东 华硕灵耀 14 骁龙版 6999 元 直达链接

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 特斯拉 FSD 即将迎来重大升级：马斯克称“避坑”功能很快上线
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 8 月 31 日消息，特斯拉的 FSD 即将迎来一项重要改进 —— 自动避开路面坑洼。特斯拉 CEO 埃隆 · 马斯克近日表示，这项功能“很快就会推出”。 事实上，“避开坑洼”已经在 FSD v14 的更新说明中出现了一段时间，被列为即将加入的改进功能。 道路上的坑洼大小、形状各不相同，但所有驾驶员对此都有一个共同的态度：都希望尽可能避开。车辆驶入或碾过坑洼，轻则可能造成轮胎和轮毂损坏、四轮定位出现问题，严重时甚至可能导致车内乘员受伤或车辆遭受重大损坏。 马斯克在当地时间上周日晚间发布的一篇帖子中表示，FSD 的自动避坑功能“很快就会推出”。 尽管已经发展到最新、功能最完善的版本，FSD 仍然存在一些短板。 目前，FSD 在避开道路障碍物方面已经表现得相当不错，例如纸箱、马粪、车辆零部件以及其他道路杂物等，都能够较好地识别和规避。不过，对于某些特殊路况，FSD 似乎仍然存在识别困难。 其中，路面坑洼以及道路布局突然发生的变化，仍是 FSD 目前比较容易遇到问题的场景。 这可能意味着，FSD 的三维环境建模系统仍需要更多数据训练，或者需要加入新的算法逻辑，以便识别那些人眼很容易发现、可能对车辆造成损坏的坑洞和道路凸起，并及时采取避让措施。 IT之家注意到，马斯克谈论“自动避坑”实际上已经有很长一段时间。早在 2019 年 4 月，就有一名特斯拉车主首次提出希望车辆能够自动避开坑洼。当时，马斯克回应称，特斯拉“肯定会”开发这项功能。 到了 2020 年 8 月，马斯克又表示，特斯拉正在对道路上的凸起和坑洼进行数据标注，让车辆能够根据情况自动减速，或者直接绕开这些路面障碍。 对于 FSD 而言，能够避开道路上的严重坑洼和其他异常路况，是实现更高级别自动驾驶不可或缺的一项能力。 尤其是在特斯拉正朝着完全自动驾驶的目标迈进之际，未来的理想状态是，车内所有乘员都可以在行驶过程

rawPayload.summary: IT之家 8 月 31 日消息，特斯拉的 FSD 即将迎来一项重要改进 —— 自动避开路面坑洼。特斯拉 CEO 埃隆 · 马斯克近日表示，这项功能“很快就会推出”。 事实上，“避开坑洼”已经在 FSD v14 的更新说明中出现了一段时间，被列为即将加入的改进功能。 道路上的坑洼大小、形状各不相同，但所有驾驶员对此都有一个共同的态度：都希望尽可能避开。车辆驶入或碾过坑洼，轻则可能造成轮胎和轮毂损坏、四轮定位出现问题，严重时甚至可能导致车内乘员受伤或车辆遭受重大损坏。 马斯克在当地时间上周日晚间发布的一篇帖子中表示，FSD 的自动避坑功能“很快就会推出”。 尽管已经发展到最新、功能最完善的版本，FSD 仍然存在一些短板。 目前，FSD 在避开道路障碍物方面已经表现得相当不错，例如纸箱、马粪、车辆零部件以及其他道路杂物等，都能够较好地识别和规避。不过，对于某些特殊路况，FSD 似乎仍然存在识别困难。 其中，路面坑洼以及道路布局突然发生的变化，仍是 FSD 目前比较容易遇到问题的场景。 这可能意味着，FSD 的三维环境建模系统仍需要更多数据训练，或者需要加入新的算法逻辑，以便识别那些人眼很容易发现、可能对车辆造成损坏的坑洞和道路凸起，并及时采取避让措施。 IT之家注意到，马斯克谈论“自动避坑”实际上已经有很长一段时间。早在 2019 年 4 月，就有一名特斯拉车主首次提出希望车辆能够自动避开坑洼。当时，马斯克回应称，特斯拉“肯定会”开发这项功能。 到了 2020 年 8 月，马斯克又表示，特斯拉正在对道路上的凸起和坑洼进行数据标注，让车辆能够根据情况自动减速，或者直接绕开这些路面障碍。 对于 FSD 而言，能够避开道路上的严重坑洼和其他异常路况，是实现更高级别自动驾驶不可或缺的一项能力。 尤其是在特斯拉正朝着完全自动驾驶的目标迈进之际，未来的理想状态是，车内所有乘员都可以在行驶过程

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 消息称长鑫存储开始试产 HBM3E 内存，有望数周内大规模量产
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 8 月 31 日消息，据《The Information》今日报道， 长鑫存储已启动 HBM3E 内存的风险试产工作 。 据报道，长鑫存储当前计划扩大产能。预计到今年年底，该公司的 DRAM 制造能力将达到每月 35 万片晶圆，未来几年的产能还将继续提高。目前长鑫的 HBM3E 生产规模依然十分有限，这意味着他们刚刚进入风险试产阶段。 虽然我们还不清楚长鑫存储 HBM3E 的具体规格。但根据 JEDEC（IT之家注：固态技术协会）规范，HBM3E 应采用 1024-bit 位宽，单引脚速率介于 9.2Gbps 至 12.4Gbps 之间，大多数标准配置的目标速率为 9.6Gbps。 在 9.6Gbps 的典型配置下，HBM3E 的总带宽可达 1.2TB/s。在采用 8 层堆叠（8-Hi）、单层 24Gb DRAM 芯片的情况下，其单个堆栈容量为 24GB；采用 12 层堆叠时，容量可达 36GB。 考虑到长鑫存储此前已具备从风险试产快速过渡到大规模量产的能力， 因此其 HBM3E 有可能在数周内进入大规模量产阶段 。 此外，长鑫存储在晶圆厂洁净室建设速度方面拥有明显优势。其建设一座晶圆厂洁净室仅需 12 个月，其他厂商通常需要两年。

observationAnalysis.titleOriginal: 比亚迪方程豹熊甜波：方程 S 和方程 S GT 将在 9 月上市
observationAnalysis.summaryOriginal: IT之家 8 月 31 日消息，比亚迪集团-方程豹事业部总经理熊甜波今日透露， 方程 S 和方程 S GT 将在 9 月上市 。 据IT之家此前报道，8 月 20 日，两款新车开启全国预订， 预订价格区间 23～28 万元 。 在 2026 成都车展上， 比亚迪方程豹全新轿跑车型方程 S 和方程 S GT 两款新车完成实车全球首秀 。 工信部申报信息显示，方程 S 长宽高分别为 5060×1967×1483/1458mm，轴距 2960mm，整备质量 2140kg，总质量 2580kg，最高车速达到 240km/h。该车搭载一台峰值功率 245kW 或 300kW 的单电机，还有 190/300kW 的双电机可选，匹配磷酸铁锂电池。 方程 S GT 长宽高分别为 5025/5095×1967×1483/1458mm，轴距 2960mm，整备质量 2170kg，总质量 2595kg，最高车速达到 240km/h。该车搭载一台峰值功率 300kW 的单电机，或 190/300kW 双电机，匹配磷酸铁锂电池。 据介绍， 方程 S 系列首发搭载比亚迪智慧生态 2.0 ，全车配备 PIN 口、磁吸及螺纹接口，实现座舱可定制、可进化、可成长。

events.titleZh: Agent Plugins package your skills, tools, and more
events.titleEn: Agent Plugins package your skills, tools, and more
events.summaryZh: Agent Plugins 1.0.0 is a new, vendor-neutral directory specification—backed by Google, Amazon, Microsoft, and others—for packaging Agent Skills and MCP servers into a single portable unit. By standardizing the manifest (plugin.json) and utilizing a fixed directory layout, it eliminates the need for developers to maintain separate wrappers or configurations to support different AI coding agents and IDEs. Google has officially joined as a Core Maintainer and already rolled out support in the Agents CLI and Data Agent Kit, allowing developers to start building and distributing interoperable plugins today.

events.titleZh: Evolving Spec-Driven Development: Conductor Now Supports Antigravity
events.titleEn: Evolving Spec-Driven Development: Conductor Now Supports Antigravity
events.summaryZh: Conductor has evolved from a Gemini CLI extension into a portable plugin, bringing conversational Spec-Driven Development (SDD) to ecosystems like Antigravity CLI and Claude. Rather than relying on strict command sequences, developers can now chat naturally with their AI assistant while it dynamically manages persistent markdown artifacts (like spec.md and plan.md) in the background. This update eliminates workflow friction while ensuring your repository remains a version-controlled, single source of truth for your project's architecture and state across different AI tools.

events.titleZh: Run Ray on TPU, Part 1: The foundations
events.titleEn: Run Ray on TPU, Part 1: The foundations
events.summaryZh: Ray 2.55 introduces official, first-class support for Google Cloud TPUs, enabling developers to run distributed Python workloads on Google's accelerators using the familiar Ray task-and-actor APIs. To handle the strict networking requirement of keeping multi-host TPU "slices" together over their Inter-Chip Interconnect (ICI), the KubeRay Operator on GKE automatically provisions and labels the underlying hardware layout. Ray Core utilizes these labels via its slice_placement_group() primitive to atomically reserve complete slices, allowing developers to deploy jobs through KubeRay, Ray Train, or Ray Serve simply by declaring a hardware topology (like "4x4") without writing custom placement code.

events.titleZh: Introducing Credentio: Open Source C++ Library for C2PA Content Credentials from Google
events.titleEn: Introducing Credentio: Open Source C++ Library for C2PA Content Credentials from Google
events.summaryZh: Credentio is a newly released, open-source C++ library from Google that allows developers to integrate high-performance, local-first validation of C2PA Content Credentials into their client and server applications. By processing assets entirely locally with a highly optimized memory footprint, the library delivers instant validation verdicts for multi-gigabyte media files without incurring cloud latency, bandwidth costs, or data privacy risks. The library currently features deep manifest parsing alongside configurable trust list integration, and is available now on Google Source with future plans to support full credential generation and embedding.

events.titleZh: Model routing with Google Cloud API Gateway
events.titleEn: Model routing with Google Cloud API Gateway
events.summaryZh: Google Cloud API Gateway now offers a model routing feature in Public Preview, allowing developers to dynamically route traffic to models like Gemini, Claude, or OpenAI OSS-GPT without hardcoding endpoints or managing open-source proxies. Developers can easily configure these routing rules directly within their OpenAPI 3.x specifications by mapping virtual model names to specific backend targets on a shared host. Once deployed, the Gateway acts as a serverless ingress layer that accepts standard OpenAI-compatible requests, automatically transcodes the payload to the native schema of the target model, and routes the traffic on the fly.

events.titleZh: Building scalable AI agents with modular prompt transpilation
events.titleEn: Building scalable AI agents with modular prompt transpilation
events.summaryZh: To resolve the scaling bottlenecks and runtime errors caused by monolithic system prompts, engineering teams should treat prompts as build artifacts by modularizing instructions into reusable templates. By running these modular "skill files" through a transpiler, developers can enforce static validation, catch missing dependencies at build time, and integrate prompt generation directly into their CI/CD pipelines. This deterministic approach prevents code drift and ultimately establishes a safe framework where agents can propose updates to their own logic via standard pull requests.

events.titleZh: 消息称英伟达重启推理预填充优化芯片 Rubin CPX 项目，设计大幅调整
events.titleEn: 消息称英伟达重启推理预填充优化芯片 Rubin CPX 项目，设计大幅调整
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，分析师郭明錤昨日表示，其最新产业调查显示 NVIDIA（英伟达）已重启人工智能推理预填充加速 GPU "Rubin CPX" 项目 ，不过其设计得到了大幅度的调整，预计 2027Q1 开始生产。 在芯片级别， 新 Rubin CPX 拥有接近标准 Rubin GPU 的算力 ， 预填充性能进一步提升 ，单体最高功耗同为 2300W， 配备 168GB HBM4 内存 （IT之家注：旧 Rubin CPX 为 128GB GDDR7，168GB 或指向 7×24GB 设计）。 来到托盘与机架级别，8 颗新 Rubin CPX 构成 1 个计算托盘；8 个计算托盘构成 1 个机架模组，内部以 Spectrum-6 全铜以太网横向扩展 (Scale-out)；新 Rubin CPX 采用独立的 MGX ETL 机架，每个机架包含 1~4 组机架模组，机架模组间横向扩展则是 Spectrum-6 + OSFP 光学方案。 而在系统层面， NVIDIA 建议 Rubin CPX 与标准 Rubin 按 1:1 配对 ，Rubin CPX ETL 机架与 Vera Rubin NVL72 机架间采用基于以太网的 RDMA 连接。 这位分析师评论称，目前的 AI 推理工作量中超过 50% 来自处理输入并建立相应的 KV Cache，新 Rubin CPX 能以更具弹性的部署方式与更低成本承接预填充负载；新 Rubin CPX 计算托盘具备 1.34TB HBM 内存，足以满足大多数长上下文预填充与 KV Cache 建立需求。

events.titleZh: 苹果首款折叠手机 iPhone Ultra 预估本月发售，首批供应“极其有限”
events.titleEn: 苹果首款折叠手机 iPhone Ultra 预估本月发售，首批供应“极其有限”
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，科技媒体 9to5Mac 昨日（8 月 31 日）发布博文，报道称苹果首款折叠手机（上市后预估名为 iPhone Ultra）上市首批供货紧张， 部分地区可能无法与美国市场同步购买。 北京时间 9 月 10 日凌晨 1 点召开的 2026 秋季发布会，对于苹果来说，具备非常重要的意义。在掌舵者方面，这是蒂姆 · 库克（Tim Cook）交棒后，新任 CEO 约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）主持召开首个新品发布会，是其履新后的首场重大公开活动。IT之家届时也会带来全程第一时间报道。 在产品方面，除了 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max 更迭外，诸多线索表明苹果会推出其首款折叠手机，上市后预估名为 iPhone Ultra。 路透社于 8 月 27 日发布博文，报道称 iPhone Ultra 预估今年 9 月在美国等少数市场发售， 且从供应链消息来看，目前没有证据表明该机会延后到 2027 年发售。 不过路透社也表示 iPhone Ultra 上市初期供货紧张， 铺货数量“极其有限” ，可能会加剧出现黄牛加价销售的情况。 在销售表现方面，彭博社此前援引市场调查机构 IDC 数据， 预估  iPhone Ultra 上市首年出货量超过 1000 万台 。

events.titleZh: 广汽传祺 M8 第 50 万辆下线，成为首个突破 50 万销量的自主品牌豪华 MPV
events.titleEn: 广汽传祺 M8 第 50 万辆下线，成为首个突破 50 万销量的自主品牌豪华 MPV
events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，广汽传祺昨晚宣布， 传祺 M8 第 50 万辆正式下线 ，该车成为了首个突破 50 万销量的自主品牌豪华 MPV，同时累计 75 个月获中国品牌豪华 MPV 销量冠军。 IT之家注意到，在广汽传祺 M8 第 50 万辆下线， 传祺 MPV 家族也已突破 90 万辆 。 据IT之家此前报道， 今年 6 月，广汽传祺向往 M8 PHEV L 正式上市 。 新车采用“一品麒麟”设计理念，采用大尺寸进气格栅搭配块状镀铬装饰，气场沉稳精致。车辆标配双侧电动滑移门，配备多幅豪华轮辋，顶配四驱 Ultra 版还搭载 ISD 智能交互尾灯，提升辨识度。 官方强调，该车搭载 1 颗激光雷达、12 个超声波雷达、3 个毫米波雷达及 11 颗摄像头，可实现城市 NDA 导航辅助、代客泊车等实用功能，车身还配备智驾专属指示灯。 该车内饰采用星河环抱式设计，配备 10.25 英寸仪表屏与 17.3 英寸中控屏，搭载高通骁龙 8295 芯片，内置 ADIGO SENSE 端云一体大模型，支持手机互联、哨兵模式等，座椅为 2+2+3 七座布局，除入门版本外，其余车型配备第二排零重力座椅；顶配车型额外配备二排扶手控制屏、多模式座椅按摩、第三排加热等舒适配置。 规格方面，该车车身尺寸为 5264mm×1898mm×1848（1829）mm，轴距 3070mm。搭载 1.5T 发动机，最大功率 125 千瓦，峰值扭矩 245 牛・米。采用前麦弗逊、后多连杆悬架组合，其中四驱 Ultra 版额外配套双阀 SDC 电磁悬架。传祺向往 M8 PHEV L 百公里亏电油耗低至 6.05L，CLTC 纯电续航 248km，综合续航超 1300km。

events.summaryZh: IT之家 9 月 1 日消息，三星电子今日宣布推出全新 14 英寸 Galaxy Book6，进一步扩充该产品线，起售价为 799 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 5,382 元人民币） 、119 万韩元 （现汇率约合 5,818 元人民币） 。 全新 Galaxy Book6 配备英特尔酷睿 3 或酷睿 5 处理器（Wildcat Lake），可选 8GB 或 16GB 内存以及 256GB、512GB 或 1TB SSD 存储；单次充电续航可达 25 小时，并支持 45W 快充（30 分钟可充入约 33% 电量）。 据介绍，其机身厚度 15.7 毫米，重量 1.35 公斤，提供银灰色（Violet Silver）和经典灰色两种配色，其中银灰色为 Galaxy Book 系列首次引入。 该机采用了 16:10 比例的 LCD 屏幕，支持防眩光技术。接口方面，该机配备两个 USB Type-C、一个 USB Type-A、HDMI 1.4 及 3.5mm 耳机孔；提供多种 AI 功能。 三星 Galaxy Book6 313.0 x 221.0 x 15.7 mm，1.35 kg 系统 Win11 25H2 专业版 / 家庭版 Linux 屏幕 14.0 英寸 LCD WUXGA (1920×1200)，350 nits CPU 英特尔酷睿 5 处理器 315 英特尔酷睿 3 处理器 304 NPU 英特尔 NPU，最高 15 TOPS GPU Intel Graphics 网络 Wi-Fi 6E、蓝牙 5.4、802.11 ax 2×2 颜色 紫银色，灰色 内存 8GB/16GB (LPDDR5X) 存储 256GB/512GB/1TB (PCIe) 相机 2MP（1080p FHD） 音频 内置双阵列数字麦克风， 立体声扬声器（2W x 2），杜比全景声 键盘 非背光键

events.titleEn: NVIDIA LPU supports 3 types of disaggregated inferencing： 1. Rubin Prefill + LPU Decode for the fas…
events.summaryZh:
NVIDIA LPU 支持 3 种分离式推理：

1. Rubin Prefill + LPU Decode，实现最快交互性
2. Rubin Prefill + Rubin Decode Attention + LPU Decode FFN，面向曲线中段
3. Rubin Prefill + Rubin Decode Verification + LPU Drafter，面向曲线中左段

在低交互性场景下，纯 Rubin 仍占优势。期待 Rubin + LPU 在 AgentX 等开源智能体基准上的性能曲线表现。

events.summaryZh: IT之家 8 月 31 日消息，今天是蒂姆 · 库克担任苹果首席执行官的最后一天。现任苹果硬件工程高级副总裁约翰 · 特努斯将在明天接任他的工作，库克后续会转任苹果董事会执行主席，并继续负责与全球政策制定者沟通等事务。 为了纪念自己 CEO 任期的最后一天，库克今天早上向苹果员工发送了一封充满感情的备忘录，这封告别信回顾了库克在苹果度过的时光，还对特努斯表达了期许。 IT之家附库克备忘录全文如下： 今天是我担任苹果首席执行官的最后一天。我知道这一天终会到来，但当它真正到来、我真正坐下来写这封信的时候，我仍然很难相信这一切已经成为现实。我热爱这家公司，也热爱背后的团队。今天我必须写出这封信，感谢你们给予我的深切关爱，和每天的付出和支持。最重要的是，我要感谢你们，让我拥有人生中最宝贵的机会 —— 成为你们的领导者。 说实话，无论人们如何评价我的成功，我都知道这一切归功于你们，是你们让我成为更好的自己。我在苹果之前从未见过、也从未与如此非凡的一群人共事。每天，我都能看到更多这样的例子。 苹果确实有着某种独到之处。我最引以为豪的东西，恰恰是年度报告永远无法体现的。这里证明了文化的力量，我们共同坚信自己创造的一切都意义非凡，我们有机会也有责任让世界变得更美好。这种使命感造就了苹果的非凡之处，苹果培育了这种精神，但我相信这些精神早在你们到来之前，就已经根植于每个人心中。并且这股动力将你们带到了这家公司，也一直驱动着你们每天创造的事物。 我们共同创造出的事业，已经远远超越任何一个人单独想象或完成的事情，这是我们成功的秘诀。我们彼此激发，互相扶持。我们之所以能够像史蒂夫 · 乔布斯当年所言那样，在世界上留下属于自己的“印记”，正是源于我们的特质与信念，以及价值观和世界观。我们何其幸运，而我又何其有幸。 正如你们所知道的那样，我不会离开苹果，但我将离开我深爱的岗位。即使我完全接受、认同自己的

events.titleEn: 华硕灵耀 14 骁龙版笔记本首销：骁龙 X 处理器，16GB+512GB 售 6999 元
events.summaryZh: IT之家 8 月 31 日消息，华硕灵耀 14 骁龙版笔记本今晚正式开售，搭载骁龙 X 处理器，配备 16GB 内存和 512GB SSD，建议零售价 7999 元， 首发 6999 元 。 该机整体厚度 13.9mm，重量 1.1Kg，B 面配备一块 14 英寸 2880×1800 分辨率 120Hz OLED 面板（峰值亮度 1100 尼特，覆盖 100% DCI-P3 色域），C 面配备 1.7mm 长键程键盘。 该机搭载 8 核心 8 线程高通骁龙 X（X1-26-100）处理器，匹配 16GB LPDDR5X 内存（频率 8448MT/s）和 512GB PCIe 4.0 SSD，内置 50Wh 电池。 I/O 方面，这款笔记本提供 USB-A 3.2 Gen 1、双 USB-C 3.2 Gen 2、HDMI 2.1 TMDS、3.5mm 音频接口。 IT之家附这款笔记本亮点如下： 京东 华硕灵耀 14 骁龙版 6999 元 直达链接

events.titleZh: 特斯拉 FSD 即将迎来重大升级：马斯克称“避坑”功能很快上线
events.titleEn: 特斯拉 FSD 即将迎来重大升级：马斯克称“避坑”功能很快上线
events.summaryZh: IT之家 8 月 31 日消息，特斯拉的 FSD 即将迎来一项重要改进 —— 自动避开路面坑洼。特斯拉 CEO 埃隆 · 马斯克近日表示，这项功能“很快就会推出”。 事实上，“避开坑洼”已经在 FSD v14 的更新说明中出现了一段时间，被列为即将加入的改进功能。 道路上的坑洼大小、形状各不相同，但所有驾驶员对此都有一个共同的态度：都希望尽可能避开。车辆驶入或碾过坑洼，轻则可能造成轮胎和轮毂损坏、四轮定位出现问题，严重时甚至可能导致车内乘员受伤或车辆遭受重大损坏。 马斯克在当地时间上周日晚间发布的一篇帖子中表示，FSD 的自动避坑功能“很快就会推出”。 尽管已经发展到最新、功能最完善的版本，FSD 仍然存在一些短板。 目前，FSD 在避开道路障碍物方面已经表现得相当不错，例如纸箱、马粪、车辆零部件以及其他道路杂物等，都能够较好地识别和规避。不过，对于某些特殊路况，FSD 似乎仍然存在识别困难。 其中，路面坑洼以及道路布局突然发生的变化，仍是 FSD 目前比较容易遇到问题的场景。 这可能意味着，FSD 的三维环境建模系统仍需要更多数据训练，或者需要加入新的算法逻辑，以便识别那些人眼很容易发现、可能对车辆造成损坏的坑洞和道路凸起，并及时采取避让措施。 IT之家注意到，马斯克谈论“自动避坑”实际上已经有很长一段时间。早在 2019 年 4 月，就有一名特斯拉车主首次提出希望车辆能够自动避开坑洼。当时，马斯克回应称，特斯拉“肯定会”开发这项功能。 到了 2020 年 8 月，马斯克又表示，特斯拉正在对道路上的凸起和坑洼进行数据标注，让车辆能够根据情况自动减速，或者直接绕开这些路面障碍。 对于 FSD 而言，能够避开道路上的严重坑洼和其他异常路况，是实现更高级别自动驾驶不可或缺的一项能力。 尤其是在特斯拉正朝着完全自动驾驶的目标迈进之际，未来的理想状态是，车内所有乘员都可以在行驶过程

events.titleZh: 消息称长鑫存储开始试产 HBM3E 内存，有望数周内大规模量产
events.titleEn: 消息称长鑫存储开始试产 HBM3E 内存，有望数周内大规模量产
events.summaryZh: IT之家 8 月 31 日消息，据《The Information》今日报道， 长鑫存储已启动 HBM3E 内存的风险试产工作 。 据报道，长鑫存储当前计划扩大产能。预计到今年年底，该公司的 DRAM 制造能力将达到每月 35 万片晶圆，未来几年的产能还将继续提高。目前长鑫的 HBM3E 生产规模依然十分有限，这意味着他们刚刚进入风险试产阶段。 虽然我们还不清楚长鑫存储 HBM3E 的具体规格。但根据 JEDEC（IT之家注：固态技术协会）规范，HBM3E 应采用 1024-bit 位宽，单引脚速率介于 9.2Gbps 至 12.4Gbps 之间，大多数标准配置的目标速率为 9.6Gbps。 在 9.6Gbps 的典型配置下，HBM3E 的总带宽可达 1.2TB/s。在采用 8 层堆叠（8-Hi）、单层 24Gb DRAM 芯片的情况下，其单个堆栈容量为 24GB；采用 12 层堆叠时，容量可达 36GB。 考虑到长鑫存储此前已具备从风险试产快速过渡到大规模量产的能力， 因此其 HBM3E 有可能在数周内进入大规模量产阶段 。 此外，长鑫存储在晶圆厂洁净室建设速度方面拥有明显优势。其建设一座晶圆厂洁净室仅需 12 个月，其他厂商通常需要两年。

events.titleZh: 比亚迪方程豹熊甜波：方程 S 和方程 S GT 将在 9 月上市
events.titleEn: 比亚迪方程豹熊甜波：方程 S 和方程 S GT 将在 9 月上市
events.summaryZh: IT之家 8 月 31 日消息，比亚迪集团-方程豹事业部总经理熊甜波今日透露， 方程 S 和方程 S GT 将在 9 月上市 。 据IT之家此前报道，8 月 20 日，两款新车开启全国预订， 预订价格区间 23～28 万元 。 在 2026 成都车展上， 比亚迪方程豹全新轿跑车型方程 S 和方程 S GT 两款新车完成实车全球首秀 。 工信部申报信息显示，方程 S 长宽高分别为 5060×1967×1483/1458mm，轴距 2960mm，整备质量 2140kg，总质量 2580kg，最高车速达到 240km/h。该车搭载一台峰值功率 245kW 或 300kW 的单电机，还有 190/300kW 的双电机可选，匹配磷酸铁锂电池。 方程 S GT 长宽高分别为 5025/5095×1967×1483/1458mm，轴距 2960mm，整备质量 2170kg，总质量 2595kg，最高车速达到 240km/h。该车搭载一台峰值功率 300kW 的单电机，或 190/300kW 双电机，匹配磷酸铁锂电池。 据介绍， 方程 S 系列首发搭载比亚迪智慧生态 2.0 ，全车配备 PIN 口、磁吸及螺纹接口，实现座舱可定制、可进化、可成长。

events.titleZh: Video generation models as world simulators
events.titleEn: Video generation models as world simulators
events.summaryZh: We explore large-scale training of generative models on video data. Specifically, we train text-conditional diffusion models jointly on videos and images of variable durations, resolutions and aspect ratios. We leverage a transformer architecture that operates on spacetime patches of video and image latent codes. Our largest model, Sora, is capable of generating a minute of high fidelity video. Our results suggest that scaling video generation models is a promising path towards building general purpose simulators of the physical world.
events.summaryEn: We explore large-scale training of generative models on video data. Specifically, we train text-conditional diffusion models jointly on videos and images of variable durations, resolutions and aspect ratios. We leverage a transformer architecture that operates on spacetime patches of video and image latent codes. Our largest model, Sora, is capable of generating a minute of high fidelity video. Our results suggest that scaling video generation models is a promising path towards building general purpose simulators of the physical world.

sourceChain.title: Video generation models as world simulators

events.titleEn: Building an early warning system for LLM-aided biological threat creation
events.summaryZh: We’re developing a blueprint for evaluating the risk that a large language model (LLM) could aid someone in creating a biological threat. In an evaluation involving both biology experts and students, we found that GPT-4 provides at most a mild uplift in biological threat creation accuracy. While this uplift is not large enough to be conclusive, our finding is a starting point for continued research and community deliberation.
